title: Alert notifications

send.title: Send notifications
send.help: The server watches the Health findings and the Overview exceptions and notifies the channels below when one holds for its wait, and again when it clears. Off by default: while off nothing is evaluated or sent. Saved immediately.

offNote: Turn notifications on to change what notifies and where.

strip.title: Overview exceptions
strip.help: The conditions the Overview exceptions strip shows.

health.title: Health findings
health.help: The findings on the unit cards, with the Health rules' own thresholds.

waitNotNumber: {{name}}: the wait must be a number of seconds

channels.title: Channels
channels.help: URLs are stored encrypted with the unit passwords and shown masked. They may point at the LAN (a self-hosted ntfy) or the internet, under the same rules as unit and LLM addresses; redirects are not followed.
channels.empty: No channels yet: alerts still show on the Overview strip.
channels.urlHidden: Stored URL is hidden. Leave it to keep it, or paste a new one.
channels.urlMissing: No URL is stored for this channel. Enter it again.

repeat.title: Remind while still firing
repeat.help: Repeat the notification for an alert that has not cleared.

recent.title: Recent
recent.help: Fired and cleared since the server started. Every notification sent or failed is also on the Activity page.
